name: Insults
overview: Scripture reveals that insults and harsh words stem from a heart lacking love and wisdom, often leading to strife and judgment. Proverbs contrasts the fool who quickly expresses wrath and despises his neighbor with the wise who hold their peace and speak words that bring healing rather than harm. Jesus warns in Matthew that anger and insulting words toward others carry severe spiritual consequences, urging believers to rely on the Lord’s justice rather than seeking personal revenge. Ultimately, love covers sins and prudent speech promotes peace, reflecting Christ’s call to reflect His character in our interactions.
